blocks.text: GLM-5.2 is a open-source language model from Z.ai, released on Jun 16, 2026.
At $0.9 input and $2.86 output per million tokens, it ranks #14 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 1.0M tokens ranks #25 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets coding, reasoning, agents workloads.
744B total / 40B active MoE; 1M-token context with IndexShare attention (2.9x per-token FLOPs reduction at full context). MIT license. Two reasoning modes: High and Max.
Models with the most shared benchmark coverage and closest scores to GLM-5.2.
